Steel Leg: Cortech Endurance Steel Leg Laminate Table
Product URL: https://www.anchortex.com/products/cortech-endurance-x-series-laminate-table-w-steel-legs
Manufacturer page: https://cortechusa.com/products/furniture/tables/the-endurance-steel-leg-laminate-tables/
Spec sheets: Steel Leg Laminate Tables, Bolt-down
Recommended H1 and Subtitle
H1: Cortech Endurance Steel Leg Laminate Table
Current H1: Cortech Endurance X‑Series Laminate Table with Steel Legs
Subtitle: Square, Round, or Rectangle Laminate Table with Welded Steel Legs for Dayrooms and Dining Areas
Current subtitle: Cortech USA Endurance Laminate Table with Steel Legs - Round, Square or Rectangle Table Tops
Revised Product Description
Headings marked [H2] should be set as H2 on the page.
The Cortech Endurance Steel Leg Laminate Table is a heavy-duty table for dayrooms and dining areas in correctional and behavioral healthcare facilities. Its 4” diameter, 14-gauge tubular steel legs are fully welded to ¼” steel mounting plates and fasten to the top with tamper-resistant screws and a metal-to-metal connection.
The seamless laminate top resists impact and has a rounded bull nose Dura-Edge for safety and comfort. Tops come in 36” and 42” square, 42” and 48” round, and 30”×72” rectangle, with a game top available on the square and 48” round tables. The table can be bolted to the floor or set on floor glides.
Top: Seamless laminate top with high impact resistance and a rounded bull nose Dura-Edge
Legs: 4” diameter, 14-gauge tubular steel legs, fully welded to ¼” steel mounting plates
Connection: The legs fasten to the top with tamper-resistant screws and a metal-to-metal connection
Top Sizes: 36”×36” or 42”×42” square, 42” or 48” round, or 30”×72” rectangle
Height: 29”
Game Top: Optional on the 36” and 42” square and the 48” round tables
Color: Gray top (other laminate finishes available on request)
Flammability Standards: Flame retardant; passes California Technical Bulletin 133
Easy Cleaning: Sound dampening, and easy to clean and maintain
Warranty: 3-year warranty on the steel legs; 5-year warranty on the laminate top
Country of Manufacture: USA, made to ISO quality standards
Available Models and Options
36SDPS / 36SDGS – 36”×36” Square: Plain or game top, Dura-Edge
42SDPS / 42SDGS – 42”×42” Square: Plain or game top, Dura-Edge
42RDPS – 42” Round: Plain top, Dura-Edge
48RDPS / 48RDGS – 48” Round: Plain or game top, Dura-Edge
3072DPS – 30”×72” Rectangle: Plain top, Dura-Edge
Vinyl Edge Models: 36SVPS, 36SVGS, 42SVPS, 42SVGS, 42RVPS, 48RVPS, 48RVGS, and 3072VPS
Installation and Options
Floor Mounting: Bolt to the floor with the bolt-down brackets (anchors not included), or use floor glides; floor bolting is recommended
Assembly: The legs attach to the top with tamper-resistant screws (T40 bit); see Cortech instructions
[H2] Applications
The Steel Leg Laminate Table suits dayrooms and dining areas that need a sturdy laminate table in round, square, or rectangle sizes.
Typical applications include:
Dining rooms and dayrooms in correctional facilities and jails
Behavioral healthcare facilities and psychiatric hospitals
Residential treatment centers and activity rooms
Explore Anchortex's Behavioral Healthcare Anti-Ligature Furniture and Prison and Detention Furniture collections for more institutional furniture.
[H2] About Cortech Endurance Series
The Cortech Endurance Series is a line of heavy-duty molded furniture for behavioral healthcare facilities, correctional institutions, and other intense use environments. Endurance products are made for durability, easy cleaning, and safety-conscious design.
The Endurance Series includes:
Beds and Bunks: Endurance beds, wall-mounted bunks, and EZ Bunk stackable temporary sleep surfaces
Seating: Benches, cubes, and the Endurance ‘In Sync’ Modular Series chairs
Tables and Desks: Molded and laminate-top tables, freestanding desks, and wall-mounted desks, including ADA models
Storage: Lockers, nightstands, open chests, and shelving
[H2] About Cortech
Cortech manufactures durable molded furniture for demanding environments, including behavioral healthcare facilities, psychiatric hospitals, correctional institutions, law enforcement facilities, and homeless and emergency shelters. Explore the full line of Cortech Behavioral Health and Prison Furniture at Anchortex.
Meta Title and Description
Meta title (55 characters): Cortech Endurance Steel Leg Laminate Table at Anchortex
Meta description (148 characters): Shop the Cortech Endurance steel leg laminate table. Square, round, or rectangle laminate tops on welded steel legs, with plain or game top options.
Notes and Questions
Series section: this is the same "About Cortech Endurance Series" section as on the EZ Bunk page.
H1: Cortech calls this the "Endurance Steel Leg Laminate Table." The X-Series is the table with the molded X-base, so I took "X-Series" out of the H1. There are 16 models, so I did not add model numbers to the H1.
Model numbers: the Cortech spec sheet lists the bolt-down models with a "B" at the end (for example 36SDPSB). Your variants end in "S," and your current page asks customers to specify G (floor glide) or B (bolt down). I kept your model numbers and listed both options under Installation and Options. Is that okay?
Vinyl edge: the current Cortech spec sheet lists vinyl edge only for the 30”×72” and 30”×96” rectangles. Your other 7 vinyl edge variants are not on it, but the 2025 Cortech catalogs say "Polyurethane or Vinyl Edge," and Cortech has a photo named 42SVGS. I listed the vinyl edge models on their own line. Would you like to keep them?
I left out "constructed of high impact polyethylene in a durable, one piece, rotationally molded design" and "legs can be easily filled with sand to weigh down as ballast." These describe the molded X-base, not steel legs. I also left out "Stain resistant," which the Cortech spec sheet does not say.
Warranty: your current page says 10-year warranty. The Cortech spec sheet says 3 years on the steel legs and 5 years on the laminate top, so I used that.
Height: the Cortech spec sheet does not give a height. The 2025 Cortech catalogs say 29”, so I used that.
Sizes: the Cortech spec sheet also lists a 30”×96” rectangle (3096DPSB and 3096VPSB), which is not on your page. Would you like to add it?
Variant names: "42SVGS - 42"x42" Square Vinyl-Edge Game-Top Steel-Legs" is written differently from the others, and "42RDPS - 42" Round, Plain, Dura-Edge Edge" has "Edge" twice. Would you like them renamed "42SVGS - 42x42 Square, Game Top, Vinyl Edge" and "42RDPS - 42" Round, Plain, Dura-Edge"?
Weight: Cortech does not publish weights. Your variants are set to 65, 60, and 86 lbs (the same as the molded X-base tables) and 255 lbs for the rectangles, which is a placeholder. Would you like me to leave them as they are?
Outdoor use: the Cortech FAQ says laminate tables are not recommended for outdoor use, so this page does not mention outdoor use.
